Nothing here is measured. Box colour gives each lead's status. Study: research/ecdlp_leads_20261018

Mechanism: covers, so class-group index calculus over F_2

g.text: L1 Coefficient collapse + projective (Farey) bases
Small-coefficient curves: level-1 reach 1/12 to 1/9 to 1/6
secp256k1, Curve25519/448, BN254, BLS12-381 G1; P-curves 1/10
L2 Eisenstein-Farey bases for j = 0 curves
zeta_3-invariant factor base at the same reach as L1
L3 Algebraic-exposure ledger, every standard prime curve
models x factor-base shapes, giving the best level-1 reach per curve
L4 Audit unchecked prime-field IC algorithms
L5 Global twist-collision relations (xedni variant)
small-x points on one quadratic twist; predicted sublinear yield
L6 Modular twists contain T_n
Eichler-Shimura: (f_E x chi) mod 2 ~ T_n
for chi of order n with chi(2) != 1; genus ~n^3
L7 Klein-quartic family (ramified)
Klein/F_2 has Jacobian ~ Res_{F_8/F_2}(E, a = 1)
extend: genus 1 + ord_n(2)(n - 1)/2
L8 Etale route, genus 1 + n(g0 - 1)
only structured family inside the L(1/2) budget
for K-163, K-283, K-409, K-571 (optimistic g0)
L9 Certified lower bounds on cover genus
a = 1: T_n is never a Jacobian; genus n impossible
at (a=0, n=3), (a=1, n=5); LMFDB: T_3, T_5 not
principally polarisable

realising Res(E) at
n = 3, 5 beyond GHS

svg.text: Closed on paper while drafting (README section "Closed on paper")

g.text: C1 Farey bases on generic-coefficient curves: level-1 reach stays 1/12 (no gain without the collapse)
C2 Special-prime quadratic orders (2^255-19: theta^2 = 38; secp256k1; P-521): equal reach, no automorphism gain
C3 Linked expansions by non-unit endomorphisms (1 + tau, sqrt(-3), halving): equivalent to re-randomising the target
C4 K-233 invariant subspaces (8 cosets of 29): linear algebra ~2^102 is under rho 2^111, but the per-solve budget 2^59 is below a degree-3 Macaulay solve (~2^73)
C5 F_2-rational norm-residue map P -> f_P on Koblitz trace-zero points: trivial by the Hasse norm theorem
C6 Characteristic-2 Farey (x = u/v, u and v in subspaces): the descended degree rises to 4
C7 Genus-n covers via an F_2-automorphism of order n: impossible for n >= 5 (ray class group); Klein is the n = 3 case
